headline: BTC tests key resistance amid 1% pullback, altcoins rally on momentum
market_phase: Consolidation with liquidity hunt near resistance
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC formed a descending channel, holding the 84k resistance zone while testing the 82.8k support; a break above 84.2k could trigger a bullish expansion, whereas failure will reinforce consolidation.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into high‑beta alts, led by QNT (+61%), GRT (+26%) and QI (+18%), indicating a short‑term risk‑on tilt.
strategy_outlook: Stay flat on spot; if BTC breaks above 84.2k with volume, add long futures with a 2% trailing stop, otherwise keep short futures targeting 82.8k.
